extracted.name: Campari spritz
extracted.description: Serve this classic crowd-pleasing aperitif spritz before a dinner party. It's made with red amaro liqueur, prosecco and garnished with an orange peel twist.
instruction_lines: Fill a tumbler with ice, then pour over the liqueur and prosecco.
Top up with sparkling water and stir, then drop in the orange peel twist to garnish.
